exposure_statement: Only manifest.json and its listed Z00 through Z06 raw/ruler PNGs were read as task evidence. All fourteen images were visually inspected at detail original, with no cropping, resizing, modification, source identification, class inference, network access, or access to other annotations. Manifest and listed PNG SHA256 values were verified. This is an independent geometric observation; no expected count was used.
instrumental_limit: Visual estimates from native raw/ruler images only. No calibrated click or tracing tool. Boxes use integer source xyxy coordinates, nominally half-open; integer notation is not one-pixel precision. Stated uncertainty is an estimated plus/minus native-pixel boundary error, not a calibrated interval. Paths are approximate centerlines with comparable uncertainty. Faint background print and isolated texture specks are not exhaustively annotated.

observable_components.geometric_description: Tall oblique loop with a thicker crossing near its middle and a descending lower return. Included beyond the left locator edge for context.
Low undulating dark stroke with several humps, separated by visible pale space from the tall loop on its left.
Dense lower-row envelope: hooked left portion and a heavier rounded/diagonal portion to the right. The small internal contact cannot establish independent writing units.
Upper-row tall loop/descending stroke and rightward bent extension. Its lower tip approaches or contacts Z01-C3; this envelope overlaps C3 at the uncertain cross-row meeting.
Short lower-row diagonal/upright strokes with a low nearly horizontal foot; possible left-edge contact with C3 is unresolved.
Small dark spot to the right of the lower-row cluster; no extended stroke confidently attached.

alternative_ownerships: The descending stroke belongs with the upper-row loop and merely meets lower-row ink.
The descending segment and lower rounded ink form one continuous trajectory.
Several strokes overlie one another at the meeting.
junctions.reason: Contact appearance does not resolve stroke order or ownership. The pale printed background further limits fine boundary judgment.

junctions.observed_relation: The low hooked part and heavier right part within Z01-C3 approach or join near the baseline.

junctions.reason: I cannot trace a unique centerline through the dark contact; abstain from a split.
